confidence_notes: Medium overall. Beer, coffee and inexpensive meal are medium confidence: based on search-result summaries of Cebu cost-of-living pages (Numbeo city and Cebu-area figures plus several guides), which are broadly consistent but partly crowd-sourced, and some are undated or older. Mid-range dinner for two is medium-low because sources diverge widely. Cocktail and wine_glass are low confidence: no solid Cebu per-drink price was found. Cocktail blends generic calculator figures and one upscale listing with the local beer relationship; wine_glass is set from the beer relationship and bottle benchmarks. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches or live listings were checked. Not adjusted for July seasonality. FX is the latest RBA observation surfaced by search (18 Nov 2026); the 19 Nov reading may not yet be published.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city substitution for food and drink: Cebu-specific aggregator figures are used directly, with Numbeo city and Cebu-area figures as the main anchors. Cocktail and wine_glass are cross-checked against the local beer price relationship, since bar and restaurant drinks typically cost a few times a domestic beer. Accommodation is a holistic model judgment for Cebu City with no comparable-city lookup.
